_note: Generic starting point; edit freely, or copy to scorecard.config.local.json (git-ignored, takes precedence) to keep your own. Each metric is scored 0 to 10 by a straight line between `worst` (0) and `best` (10); an area is the weighted mean of its metrics that have data; a metric whose source is not configured scores 'no data', never a false zero. Set `original` on an area to your own earlier rating to see measured vs judged side by side. The baseline is the 30 days that end 14 days ago, so it never overlaps the last 14 days; use `from` and `to` (YYYY-MM-DD) for fixed dates instead. The trend matters more than any absolute number.
